## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a low-latency streaming ingestion path that remains robust under adversarial activity, with strong replay protection and per-tenant isolation.

## Key Concepts

- Real-time streaming ingestion, idempotent writes, and nonce-based replay protection
- Cryptographic signing, timestamping, and ordering hints
- Backpressure, fault tolerance, and per-tenant quotas
- End-to-end latency targets and testing via fault injection

## Code Example

```javascript
function verifyShard(shard, publicKeyStore) {
  const { nonce, signature, payload } = shard
  if (isNonceUsed(nonce)) return false
  return verifySignature(payload, signature, publicKeyStore[shard.tenant_id])
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you measure latency and jitter under load?
- How would you handle out-of-order shards without breaking guarantees?
